cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: An apparent escape can fail too; no third-attempt privilege and no entry after an earlier fill.
cases.opportunity_branch: If a later accepted escape obtains its own continuation trigger before cutoff, evaluate it independently.
cases.protective_response: Compare a registered wait-for-acceptance policy with skip; keep the trade token unused.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: No automatic 0.8R target or NR7 priority; compression may never expand profitably.
cases.opportunity_branch: Study compression-to-expansion under OHLCV labels and existing targets, never call it a VIX trade.
cases.protective_response: Flag missing VIX; block VIX-dependent policies. A separately proven OHLCV-only recipe may still run.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: A quiet next bar does not prove shock ended; no claims of safety from a proxy.
cases.opportunity_branch: A valid later stable acceptance/retest is only an independent OHLCV candidate.
cases.protective_response: Block the missing overlay; observe shocks, recheck pending proposal geometry and data integrity.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: A large gap can keep being accepted. Refute the fade on registered reclaim before entry.
cases.opportunity_branch: Confirmed rejection may arm an unfilled-gap fade with a separately tested stop and remaining target room.
cases.protective_response: Compare no-chase, wait-retest and rejection-watch plans. Do not flip from gap size alone.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: The catalyst is unknown, the shock may repeat, and an open fixed-exit paper trade does not gain a new discretionary stop rule.
cases.opportunity_branch: Only a later independently valid price setup; no claim that the shock itself is profit opportunity.
cases.protective_response: Represent unobservable event risk, stress adverse paths, cancel invalid unapproved plans, or halt corrupt data.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Failed breakout does not imply profitable reversal; reclaim or no room invalidates the alternative.
cases.opportunity_branch: Independent rejection plus untouched PDC and target room may support a gap fade.
cases.protective_response: Do not keep the invalid original entry alive; arm alternative fade and reclaim branches before any approval.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Never tighten or widen the stop ad hoc just to force a better displayed R multiple.
cases.opportunity_branch: A later planned pullback can give a different feasible entry only if its complete policy is proven.
cases.protective_response: Reject uneconomic plans; compare separately registered timing/structural-stop recipes or skip.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Later confirmation can be expensive or false; no automatic 3R target or volume-hammer magic.
cases.opportunity_branch: A genuine later accepted expansion can be eligible under the continuation policy.
cases.protective_response: Compare persistence or expansion confirmation against first break; enforce minimum valid geometry.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: The next attractive candle does not repair a corrupt source; rebased OR is a separate experiment.
cases.opportunity_branch: With valid data, later acceptance or rejection can form a normal permitted setup.
cases.protective_response: Separate valid unusual bar from invalid data. Quarantine inconsistency; no silent range rebasing.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: No retrospective entry at the earlier level, and no afternoon exception.
cases.opportunity_branch: A new valid pre-cutoff observation may create a new unapproved plan; otherwise no opportunity.
cases.protective_response: Use the actual 10:15 entry cutoff and per-proposal expiry, not the source 11:30 limit.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: No re-entry after an actual stop, even when the pattern later looks better.
cases.opportunity_branch: Before the first entry only, a later independently confirmed reclaim/escape can be evaluated.
cases.protective_response: After any filled trade, enforce daily completion. Before entry, compare wait/skip rather than blind retries.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Event ambiguity or insufficient time/room can leave no opportunity; no automatic post-result safety.
cases.opportunity_branch: Later post-event acceptance/rejection could select an existing family when its data and controller are proved.
cases.protective_response: Mark event awareness unavailable; a future dated gate is a separately tested policy, not an assumed 09:45 safe zone.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Do not create after-10:15 entries as compensation for waiting through an event.
cases.opportunity_branch: Only qualifying pre-cutoff evidence after uncertainty clears; often the entry window will be over.
cases.protective_response: Block event-dependent strategy or follow a separately validated OHLCV-only policy; known-window avoidance is configurable risk policy.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Two confirmations do not make every extreme event day safe.
cases.opportunity_branch: No automatic conversion; only independent valid first-hour price setups within supported policy.
cases.protective_response: Future calendar rule can skip or require separately validated conditions. Preserve adverse-path stress.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: The artificial component of a gap is not a free fade opportunity; corrected history can invalidate old proof.
cases.opportunity_branch: An authentic residual gap after verified adjustment can be evaluated afresh under its exact policy.
cases.protective_response: Reconcile comparable prices; block known basis inconsistency; never add a universal dividend percentage blindly.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: An OHLC print is not proof that the desired quantity could enter or exit.
cases.opportunity_branch: No inherent trading opportunity; this is an execution/safety hazard.
cases.protective_response: Block policies requiring unavailable eligibility; stress exit non-observability and preserve unknown outcomes.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Do not invent current or historical restrictions from volatility or names.
cases.opportunity_branch: No automatic inverse trade. Data/eligibility review is the useful action.
cases.protective_response: Keep status unknown rather than safe; validate applicability before any optional exclusion policy.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Higher volume does not prove tight spread; future fill-bar volume cannot select earlier size.
cases.opportunity_branch: A later feasible entry can be considered before approval if valid and independently supported.
cases.protective_response: Apply proved economic/capacity constraints; delay/reduce only through registered policy or skip.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: A derivatives status cannot establish an advantageous cash-stock fade or squeeze.
cases.opportunity_branch: No inherent directional opportunity from this label.
cases.protective_response: Mark overlay missing and verify applicability before any gate. No blanket cash prohibition inferred here.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Bad data is not a market signal; repeated model agreement cannot validate a bad source.
cases.opportunity_branch: Only after verified recovery can new valid observations support normal policy.
cases.protective_response: Halt affected decisions, reconcile, replay with a new version if corrected; never fabricate a price.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Do not add broker integration or assume a guaranteed flat price to simulate a perfect outcome.
cases.opportunity_branch: No market inversion; better accounting and a protected allowance are the benefit.
cases.protective_response: Model approval expiry, missed fills and flat deadlines under the research contract.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: A profitable leaked backtest is not salvaged by a risk filter.
cases.opportunity_branch: No trading opportunity. A corrected research result is the useful output.
cases.protective_response: Invalidate affected results, fix availability, recompute correctly and require fresh proof.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Do not presume the historically documented bug still exists or is fixed without current test evidence.
cases.opportunity_branch: No trade conversion. Correct economics can change which strategy is valid.
cases.protective_response: Block affected promotion until stop/fill/cost semantics match; audit old results.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: A pin can break; no forced cap-to-pain or automatic fade bias.
cases.opportunity_branch: A valid unfilled-gap fade or accepted breakout can be studied independently, not called gamma/pain proof.
cases.protective_response: Keep mechanism unknown; observe near-level congestion only as OHLCV behavior under a separate label.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Trailing or runner management would change the frozen exit policy and is not enabled.
cases.opportunity_branch: Only a permitted fixed-exit continuation with its own proof.
cases.protective_response: Use price-path stress, extension and entry feasibility; no fabricated GEX.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Neither an OI wall nor a candle rejection guarantees a ceiling; reclaim refutes the fade.
cases.opportunity_branch: A rejected price break can arm a valid gap fade only with independent trigger and remaining room.
cases.protective_response: Keep derivatives inference blocked; apply normal target-room/economic policy if supported.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Do not substitute next-month data or infer basis mechanically without actual records.
cases.opportunity_branch: No direct trade conversion inside this core.
cases.protective_response: Validate data contract or disable basis-related policies.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: A winning week does not erase decay evidence; windows overlap and need adequate support.
cases.opportunity_branch: A separately proved alternative controller may be researched/promoted later, not fitted to the latest losses and deployed instantly.
cases.protective_response: Warn/suspend through frozen governance; keep champion model fixed until reviewed.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: The controller itself must be tested; leaf strategy proofs do not prove adaptive switching.
cases.opportunity_branch: No market inverse. Stronger selection evidence is the opportunity.
cases.protective_response: Log every branch/model/threshold search; nested chronological evaluation; sealed final test; simplify unsupported models.

cases.alternative_failure_or_limit: Synthetic continuations, repeated prompts and many rows from one day do not create independent market evidence.
cases.opportunity_branch: Collect prospective observations and shadow alternatives until useful inference is possible.
cases.protective_response: Return UNSUPPORTED/UNESTIMATED, not confidence from an arbitrary universal sample count.
